candidate.definition_en: To prepare a preliminary version of a text; or to recruit someone for military service.
candidate.explanation_ar: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند حد في الجيش.

senses.definition_en: To prepare a preliminary version of a text, speech, or plan.
senses.explanation_ar: يكتب مسودة أو يُعد نسخة أولية من نص أو وثيقة أو خطة.
examples: The legal team will draft a new contract tomorrow.
You should draft a preliminary outline before writing the final essay.

senses.definition_en: To select or recruit someone for compulsory military service.
examples: The military may draft eligible citizens during a national crisis.
The legal team will draft a new contract tomorrow.
You should draft a preliminary outline before writing the final essay.
The military may draft eligible citizens during a national crisis.
candidate.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم.. بيعمل 'Draft' يعني بيجهز ويخطط.
